tools.name: about_wisheroo
tools.description: What Wisheroo is, who it is for, how songs and video wish lists work, and its policies. Call this first when someone asks about Wisheroo or wants a personal gift idea.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Wisheroo song products and prices in USD. The preview is free; payment happens only after the buyer hears the preview and approves the lyrics. Video wish lists are free.

tools.name: list_occasions
tools.description: Holidays and occasions Wisheroo covers, with the next date of each and its page. Use to suggest a timely gift.

tools.name: list_sample_songs
tools.description: Example Wisheroo songs with links to listen and their cover art. These are samples made from example memories, not customer songs.

tools.name: faq
tools.description: Answers to common questions about Wisheroo songs and video wish lists (AI use, changes, speed, names, privacy, cost, who sees the video).

tools.name: start_song_link
tools.description: Build a link that opens the Wisheroo song form already filled with the recipient's name and occasion. Give the link to the person; they add the memories and finish on wisheroo.com. Nothing is created or charged by this tool.

tools.name: start_wish_list_link
tools.description: Build a link that opens the free Wisheroo video wish list recorder for an occasion, optionally naming who will watch it (for example Grandma). Nothing is created by this tool.
